frontmatter.title: Project: Ocean Only Configuration - The Bare Minimum

children.value: This project is all about how we create the most basic ocean_only domain to shake things out and get spinning as fast as possible. This is one way of testing everything before we get into our research questions.
Copying the file from your CrocoDash checkout:

The first thing we are going to do is think about how to get a domain. Scaling data is available online, but a 100x100 point domain is relatively quick. If we provide ~40 cores for the ocean, it’ll run within a few minutes.
We’ll pick a 100x100 point horizontal grid and a standard vertical grid.

from CrocoDash.grid import Grid
from CrocoDash.vgrid import VGrid

grid = Grid(
  resolution = 0.05, # in degrees
  xstart = 278.0, # min longitude in [0, 360]
  lenx = 5.0, # longitude extent in degrees
  ystart = 7.0, # min latitude in [-90, 90]
  leny = 5.0, # latitude extent in degrees
  name = "basic_grid",
)


vgrid  = VGrid.hyperbolic(
    nk = 75, # number of vertical levels
    depth = 2000,
    ratio=20.0 # target ratio of top to bottom layer thicknesses
)
Now that we have our horizontal and vertical grids, we need to setup our bathymetry. Normally, we’d use the
function to go from a bathymetry dataset to grid bathymetry. However, as a first step we’ll skip the dataset entirely and use an idealized bathymetry.
provides helpers mirroring MOM6’s built-in TOPO_CONFIG options, such as
, the analytic basin shape used in MOM6’s idealized double gyre case.

from CrocoDash.topo import Topo

topo = Topo(
    grid = grid,
    min_depth = 9.5, # in meters
)

topo.set_spoon(max_depth = 2000, dedge = 200)

topo.depth.plot()
Great! So I’m going to create my case now, and this step will hardly ever change!

from pathlib import Path
from CrocoDash.case import Case

# CESM case (experiment) name
casename = "basic_ocean"

# CESM source root (Update this path accordingly!!!)
cesmroot ="<CESM>"

# Place where all your input files go 
inputdir = Path("<inputdir>") / casename
    
# CESM case directory
caseroot = Path("<casedir>") / casename


case = Case(
    cesmroot = cesmroot,
    caseroot = caseroot,
    inputdir = inputdir,
    ocn_grid = grid,
    ocn_vgrid = vgrid,
    ocn_topo = topo,
    project = "ncgd0011", # Update this with your project code
    override = True,
    machine = "derecho",
    compset = "CR_JRA"
)

I also think we can run for 60 days. That doesn’t sound too bad.
